t.zh: 一个点也可以看成从原点指向它的箭头。<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>只能把给定的箭头整段接上；要走到一半，得把箭头缩短。<wiki-ref to="scalar-multiple"></wiki-ref>让箭头沿它所在的直线伸缩，乘的数为负时掉头；<part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: A point can be read as the arrow from the origin to it. <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> can only lay the given arrows end to end, whole; to go halfway, an arrow must be shortened. A <wiki-ref to="scalar-multiple"></wiki-ref> stretches or shrinks an arrow along its own line, turning it round when the number is negative; <part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

after.zh: 数乘只改变箭头的长短和朝向，不让它离开所在的直线。
after.en: Scaling changes only an arrow's length and sense; it never leaves its line.

brief.zh: 交出 p、q 两点连线的中点。
brief.en: Give the midpoint of the segment from p to q.

hint.zh: 中点的箭头与 p + q 方向相同。
hint.en: The midpoint's arrow points the same way as p + q.
